description:
#### PR Classification
Feature and configuration refactor, CI/CD improvement, and documentation update.

#### PR Summary
This PR refactors the VS Code extension's configuration and settings, enhances language support, and modernizes WinGet CI workflows for robust release automation.
- BannerUtils.ts, FigletPanel.ts, FigletSettingsPanel.ts, and related UI: Removed defaultFont setting/command, now persist last used font in global state, and simplified settings UI.
- LanguageCommentStyles.ts: Added dedicated Batch file (::) comment style and updated language mapping for bat/cmd/dos/batch.
- publish-figprint.yml: Rewrote WinGet manifest generation to be fully manual, added schema headers, improved error handling, and clarified release notes.
- LICENSE, ChangeLog-2026.md, ChangeLog.md, and readme.md: Updated documentation, changelog, and license with new banners, copyright years, and WinGet status.
- tsconfig.json and codebase: Improved type safety and code clarity, including Node.js types.
